subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should this fix expose `deferred` as a permanent public and persisted cron status across protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, and plugin SDK, or keep yielded waiting internal while using existing public statuses?
rationale: Current main already has the internal descendant-owned wake invariant; the additional durable status is a separable API and product decision with upgrade consequences that tests alone cannot settle.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Land the lifecycle and delivery correction while projecting existing public statuses until a dedicated contract proposal is approved.

options.title: Adopt deferred publicly
options.body: Accept the new status only after exhaustive downstream coverage and fresh-install and upgrade proof are complete.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Land the lifecycle and delivery correction while projecting existing public statuses until a dedicated contract proposal is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows direct ownership of the subagent lifecycle and run-manager boundaries where this invariant lives.
